$comment: Risky changes of a config plan (docs/plans/CONFIG_AS_CODE.md, "Phase 0 contract": Risky changes). A plan with any change matching a rule waits for an approval (config.approve). A change matches a rule when its op is in `ops`, its path matches one of `paths` (JSON Pointers into the resolved file; * matches one reference token), the unit's type is in `unit_types` (when given), the environment is a production one (when `production_only`), and `condition` holds (when given). Conditions: became_true (before is not true, after is true), became_false (before is true, after is not), decrease (after < before; sizes compared in bytes, durations in seconds), has_volumes (the removed unit had volumes). The first matching rule sets Change.rule and Change.reason.

rules.reason: Changing a database engine replaces the instance and its data.
A database version is a major version: changing it runs a major upgrade.
Making a database public publishes its port to the internet.
Moving a database to another server moves its data.
Removing a database's backup schedule stops its backups.
Turning point-in-time recovery off drops the recovery window.
Removing point-in-time recovery drops the recovery window.
A shorter recovery window deletes older recovery points.
Disabling a database's backup schedule stops its backups.
Deleting a database drops its data.
Moving a volume to another server moves its data.
Removing a volume's backup schedule stops its backups.
Disabling a volume's backup schedule stops its backups.
A volume removed from the file holds data.
Shrinking a sized volume can lose data that no longer fits.
The removed unit holds data.
Deleting a unit deletes its service (a run deletes only with allow_destroy, else it detaches).
The removed unit has volumes holding data.
Changing a production deploy strategy changes how releases go live.
Changing the servers of a production environment moves where it runs.
Removing a production domain takes it offline.
Changing whether an environment is production changes which changes need approval.
